result.instructions: Tools for Nivoda, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find round diamonds between 1 and 1.5 carats, colour D or E, with a photo, cheapest first."; "Show VS1 or better emerald cuts with excellent cut and polish, sorted by price per carat."; "Get the details and certificate for this diamond from my last search.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Nivoda data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nivoda_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nivoda_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nivoda_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. nivoda_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nivoda_search_diamonds
tools.title: Search diamonds
tools.description: Search the Nivoda diamond inventory by shape, carat range, colour, clarity, cut, polish, symmetry, grading lab, lab-grown and media filters. Returns up to 50 items per call with price, discount, certificate details and media links, plus total_count for paging. Nivoda GraphQL: diamonds_by_query.

shapes.description: Shape names, for example ROUND, OVAL, PRINCESS, CUSHION, EMERALD, PEAR, RADIANT.

lab_grown.description: true = lab-grown only, false = natural only.

has_image.description: true = only stones with a photo.

has_video360.description: true = only stones with a 360 video.

tools.name: nivoda_get_diamond
tools.title: Get a diamond
tools.description: Get one diamond by the item id from nivoda_search_diamonds, with its current price, discount, certificate details and media links. Nivoda GraphQL: get_diamond_by_id.

diamond_id.description: The item id from nivoda_search_diamonds (the top-level id of one item in the results).

preferred_currency.description: Currency for the prices (the account default when omitted).
